newsitem.title: FRANCE: French retail permit requests void pre-July 6.
newsitem.headline: French retail permit requests void pre-July 6.

text.p: France's minister for small business, Jean-Pierre Raffarin, said on Sunday requests submitted before July 6 for permits to open large retail stores were void.

A statement from the minister's office said that an April 1996 law suspended such requests for six months and that this move to restrict large retail center openings had been confirmed by a further law on July 5.

"In line with the law, requests registered before its date of publication, that is July 6, and on which departmental commissions had not yet given their verdict, are declared void and can be resubmitted once the regulatory texts are published as long as they are in conformity with the new measures," said the statement.
